body.zh-Hant: 拉薩羅·卡德納斯1895年5月21日生於米卻肯州的希基爾潘，父母是達馬索·卡德納斯與費莉西塔斯·德爾里奧。1913年他以中尉身分加入立憲革命，1915年3月27日在阿瓜普列塔投入普魯塔科·埃利亞斯·卡列斯將軍的部隊。1923年他在對抗德拉韋爾塔派叛軍的戰鬥中表現突出，1928年4月1日晉升為師級將軍。
body.en: Lázaro Cárdenas was born on 21 May 1895 in Jiquilpan de Juárez, Michoacán, to Dámaso Cárdenas and Felicitas del Río. In 1913 he joined the Constitutionalist Revolution with the rank of lieutenant, and on 27 March 1915 he joined the forces of General Plutarco Elías Calles at Agua Prieta. In 1923 he distinguished himself in combat against the Delahuertista rebels, and on 1 April 1928 he was promoted to General of Division.

heading.zh-Hant: 州長、黨主席與內閣職務
heading.en: Governor, party president and cabinet posts

body.zh-Hant: 1928年卡德納斯當選家鄉米卻肯州州長，推動土地改革並扶植勞工與農民組織。他因任內數度請假，先後出任國民革命黨主席（1930至1931年）、內政部長（1932年）與戰爭部長（1933年）；政府簡介說他是在奧爾蒂斯·魯維奧總統任內任內政部長，在阿韋拉多·L·羅德里格斯總統任內任戰爭與海軍部長。1933年他被推為國民革命黨的總統候選人，實質上由卡列斯選定。
body.en: In 1928 Cárdenas was elected governor of his home state of Michoacán, where he set out to accelerate agrarian reform and foster labor and peasant organizations. He took several leaves of absence to serve as president of the National Revolutionary Party (1930–1931), minister of government (1932) and minister of war (1933); the government biography says he was Secretary of Government under President Pascual Ortiz Rubio and of War and Navy under President Abelardo L. Rodríguez. In 1933 he was chosen, in effect by Calles, as the party's presidential candidate.

heading.zh-Hant: 總統任期、戰時軍職與逝世

body.zh-Hant: 1934至1940年卡德納斯任墨西哥總統。任內他沒收約4500萬英畝私有土地，以村社形式分配；1938年3月他將英美石油公司收歸國有，並設立國營的墨西哥石油公司；他選擇偏右的阿維拉·卡馬喬接班。1942年他被任命為太平洋軍區司令，並自該年起至1945年出任國防部長。他於1970年10月19日去世。
body.en: Cárdenas was president of Mexico from 1934 to 1940. He confiscated some 45 million acres of private land and distributed it as ejidos; in March 1938 he expropriated the Anglo-American oil companies and established the state oil company Petróleos Mexicanos, and he opted for the right-of-center Ávila Camacho as his successor. In 1942 he was named commander of the Pacific Military Region and from that year until 1945 served as Secretary of National Defense. He died on 19 October 1970.

body.zh-Hant: 馬塞洛·T·德阿爾韋亞爾1868年10月4日生於布宜諾斯艾利斯，職業是律師。他出身布宜諾斯艾利斯的大地主望族，在布宜諾斯艾利斯大學念法律時投入萊安德羅·阿列姆的政治改革活動與激進公民聯盟（UCR）。他支持該黨1893年的起事，起事失敗後自我流放歐洲。
body.en: Marcelo Torcuato de Alvear was born in Buenos Aires on 4 October 1868 and was a lawyer by profession. Born into a prominent landed Buenos Aires family, he became involved, as a law student at the University of Buenos Aires, in the political reform activities of Leandro Alem and the Radical Civic Union (UCR). He supported the UCR's 1893 uprising and, after its failure, went into self-imposed exile in Europe.

heading.zh-Hant: 國會議員、駐法大使與總統任期
heading.en: Congress, the Paris embassy and the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 阿爾韋亞爾1912年當選國會議員。1916至1920年他擔任伊里戈延政府駐法國大使，任內因反對阿根廷在第一次世界大戰中保持中立，與伊里戈延首度發生嚴重分歧。1922年10月12日他就任總統，副總統是埃爾皮迪奧·岡薩雷斯，任期至1928年10月12日。任內他設法處理國債問題；伊里戈延的黨內對手另組政黨，但他本人並未推動。
body.en: Alvear was elected to Congress in 1912. From 1916 to 1920 he served as Irigoyen's ambassador to France, where his opposition to Argentina's neutrality in the First World War produced his first serious differences with Irigoyen. His term as president ran from 12 October 1922 to 12 October 1928, with Elpidio González as vice president. As president he tried to solve the problem of the national debt; Irigoyen's rivals within the UCR organized a separate party, though Alvear himself did not promote it.

body.zh-Hant: 1930年政變後，阿爾韋亞爾被迫流亡巴西，後來返國接掌激進黨，支持激進黨的選舉棄權政策直到1935年，之後成為激進黨對當時非民主政府的忠誠反對派領袖。他在1937年是激進黨的總統候選人，但落敗，那次選舉舞弊猖獗。他於1942年3月23日在布宜諾斯艾利斯去世。
body.en: After the 1930 coup Alvear was forced into exile in Brazil, then returned to take control of the Radical party, whose policy of electoral abstention he supported until 1935, and afterwards led the Radicals' loyal opposition to the non-democratic governments of the period. He lost as the Radicals' presidential candidate in 1937, in an election marked by widespread fraud. He died in Buenos Aires on 23 March 1942.

body.en: He ascended the throne in 1933 after the assassination of his father Nadir. In 1955 he took part in the Bandung Conference. In 1973 he was overthrown by a military coup led by his cousin and brother-in-law Daoud Khan. After twenty-nine years of exile in Italy, he returned home in 2002 following the collapse of the Taliban regime.
